Definition
[Admissible class for a nonlinear eigenvalue problem] 1. ch8:8.4.1-def-1\group Constrained Minimization The admissible class is \[ \mathcal{A} := \{ w \in H_0^1(U) \mid J[w] = 0\} . \]
